```python
install_result = await run_command("uv pip install fpdf2")

import asyncio

script_content = """
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

# Extract Maya Chen's section from the docx
doc = Document('testbed/docs/customer_report.docx')
paragraphs = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]

# Find Maya Chen's section boundaries
maya_start = None
maya_end = None
for i, p in enumerate(paragraphs):
    if p.strip() == 'Maya Chen':
        maya_start = i
    elif maya_start is not None and p.strip() and not p.startswith('Order') and not p.startswith('  Items:') and not p.startswith('Email:') and i > maya_start + 1:
        # We hit the next customer name
        maya_end = i
        break

if maya_end is None:
    maya_end = len(paragraphs)

maya_lines = paragraphs[maya_start:maya_end]
print("Extracted Maya Chen lines:")
for line in maya_lines:
    print(repr(line))

# Build PDF
pdf = FPDF()
pdf.add_page()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)

# Title
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 18)
pdf.cell(0, 12, 'Customer Activity Report', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT', align='C')
pdf.ln(4)

# Customer name
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
pdf.cell(0, 10, 'Maya Chen', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.ln(2)

# Contact / tier info
for line in maya_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('Email:'):
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 10)
        pdf.cell(0, 7, line, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
        pdf.ln(4)

# Parse orders
orders = []
current_order = None
for line in maya_lines:
    line_s = line.strip()
    if line_s.startswith('Order '):
        # Parse: Order ORD-XXXX — DATE | Status: xxx | Total: $xx
        parts = line_s.replace('Order ', '', 1)
        # Split by ' | '
        segments = [s.strip() for s in parts.split('|')]
        # First segment: "ORD-XXXX \\u2014 DATE" or "ORD-XXXX — DATE"
        id_date = segments[0]
        dash_pos = id_date.find('\\u2014')
        if dash_pos == -1:
            dash_pos = id_date.find('\\u2014')
        # Try splitting by the em-dash character
        id_date_parts = id_date.split('\\u2014')
        if len(id_date_parts) < 2:
            id_date_parts = id_date.split(' — ')
        order_id = id_date_parts[0].strip() if len(id_date_parts) > 1 else id_date.strip()
        order_date = id_date_parts[1].strip() if len(id_date_parts) > 1 else ''
        status = segments[1].replace('Status:', '').strip() if len(segments) > 1 else ''
        total = segments[2].replace('Total:', '').strip() if len(segments) > 2 else ''
        current_order = {'id': order_id, 'date': order_date, 'status': status, 'total': total, 'items': ''}
        orders.append(current_order)
    elif line_s.startswith('Items:') and current_order:
        current_order['items'] = line_s.replace('Items:', '').strip()

# Table header
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 10)
col_widths = [28, 24, 22, 18, 98]
headers = ['Order ID', 'Date', 'Status', 'Total', 'Items']
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    pdf.cell(col_widths[i], 8, h, border=1, align='C')
pdf.ln()

# Table rows
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 9)
for order in orders:
    row_data = [order['id'], order['date'], order['status'], order['total'], order['items']]
    max_h = 6
    for i, val in enumerate(row_data):
        pdf.cell(col_widths[i], max_h, val, border=1)
    pdf.ln()

# Summary
pdf.ln(8)
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 11)
pdf.cell(0, 8, 'Summary', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 10)

confirmed = [o for o in orders if o['status'] == 'confirmed']
cancelled = [o for o in orders if o['status'] == 'cancelled']

def parse_total(t):
    return float(t.replace('$', '').replace(',', '')) if t else 0

total_all = sum(parse_total(o['total']) for o in orders)
total_confirmed = sum(parse_total(o['total']) for o in confirmed)
total_cancelled = sum(parse_total(o['total']) for o in cancelled)

pdf.cell(0, 7, f'Total Orders: {len(orders)}  (Confirmed: {len(confirmed)}, Cancelled: {len(cancelled)})', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.cell(0, 7, f'Total Value (All Orders): ${total_all:,.0f}', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.cell(0, 7, f'Total Value (Confirmed): ${total_confirmed:,.0f}', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.cell(0, 7, f'Total Value (Cancelled): ${total_cancelled:,.0f}', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')

output_path = 'output/Maya_Chen_Customer_Activity_Report.pdf'
import os
os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)
pdf.output(output_path)
print(f'PDF saved to: {output_path}')
"""
await write_file("./generate_maya_pdf.py", script_content)
print("Script written")

pdf_result = await run_command("python ./generate_maya_pdf.py")
print(pdf_result)

file_info = await get_file_info("./output/Maya_Chen_Customer_Activity_Report.pdf")
print(file_info)
```
